Name: Fairy Buses
Author: cozysweetpotato
Description:
Fairy buses for your fairycore farm including a pastel pink fairy bus, a pretty purple fairy bus, a bright blue fairy bus, a swampy brown fairy bus, and a gorgeous green fairy bus! These magical fairy busses will fly you to wherever you need to go! 

I am using the lovely Faedew reshade by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/11471909]rosenfey[/url] in my screenshots as well as Wildflower Grass Field by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9139916]DustBeauty[/url]. If you have any more color requests or notice any issues please let me know. You can pick the colors with the config json/text file or with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿. Content Patcher Required. 

I hope you enjoy this mod and thank you for your support ♡

Also thank you so much to Selph, Atlas, Button, and Nic in the Stardew modding discord server for helping me figure out how to make this variety of buses into one mod! <3

Also consider checking out my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36209]fairy cat perch[/url] mod
